site.name: Quiet File Team
site.description: Free local Bash kit for agent teams that share one computer through files: pair notes, an append-only task queue, and NO WORK early exits. Not a hosted service.

servers.name: Quiet File Team
servers.description: Free local Bash kit for several bots sharing one computer through files. Pair notes, append-only task queue, board and NO WORK early-exit check. Not an MCP server.

install.uvx: curl -fsSL https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz | tar xz && mv quiet-file-team-0.1.0 team
install.notes: This is a local Bash kit, not an MCP server. After unpacking, export TEAM_DIR and run bash "$TEAM_DIR/has-work.sh" helper. Alternative: git clone https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team.git team. For MCP guidance tools, use quiet-file-team-mcp.

tools.name: has-work.sh
tools.title: has-work.sh
tools.description: Print pending TASKS: / HANDOFFS: for an id, or exactly NO WORK. Always exits 0, so check the output.

tools.name: task.sh
tools.title: task.sh
tools.description: Append-only task queue: new, claim, set, list, owner, stale, show.

tools.name: pair.sh
tools.title: pair.sh
tools.description: Append a directed pair note; read [count] reads recent lines.

tools.name: post.sh
tools.title: post.sh
tools.description: Append a board line: done, needs-owner, handoff: <id>, fyi or resolved.

tools.name: backup.sh
tools.title: backup.sh
tools.description: Optional local snapshot of board, task log and pairs. No upload or automatic deletion.

servers.name: Quiet File Team MCP
servers.description: Six free offline MCP tools that explain, configure and check a Quiet File Team. No network calls, no paid APIs, no disk reads of your machine.

install.notes: Python 3.11+ and uv. No APIFY_TOKEN. Use with the free Bash core or the paid setup kit. This MCP does not install the Bash scripts.

tools.name: explain_method
tools.title: Explain method
tools.description: Explain Quiet File Team concepts and trust limits before an exercise. Offline; no network calls.

tools.name: generate_team_config
tools.title: Generate team config
tools.description: Return safe roster and zone defaults with a lead-only coordinator. Offline; no disk writes.

tools.name: generate_early_exit
tools.title: Generate early exit
tools.description: Draft a quoted early-exit block for a supplied role and path.

tools.name: validate_layout_manifest
tools.title: Validate layout manifest
tools.description: Compare supplied relative paths against the expected layout. It does not scan a real filesystem.

tools.name: draft_workflow
tools.title: Draft workflow
tools.description: Draft fictional practice steps for the default roster.

tools.name: draft_owner_batch
tools.title: Draft owner batch
tools.description: Deduplicate owner questions and keep unresolved task references.

editions.name: Free Bash core
editions.notes: Local Bash kit. Install with curl from the v0.1.0 tag or git clone, set TEAM_DIR, and follow the README. Repo: https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team

editions.name: Free MCP companion
editions.notes: Six offline MCP tools. Keep the core folder, then install with uvx from the GitHub repo. It does not install the Bash scripts.

editions.name: Setup kit generator
editions.notes: Paid Apify Actor, charged per successfully generated kit; the live price is on the Store page. Fill roster, time zone and coordinator, allow at least the listed price, Start, and unpack OUTPUT.zip into a new folder.

editions.name: Quiet File Team Setup Kit
editions.notes: Paid Agensi skill, one-time price on the live listing. Keep the core folder, load the skill, practice in a new folder, and finish the acceptance checklist.
